anomalies.observed: The LDO output is only on net +3.3V. Net +3V3 contains pull-ups, decoupling, U11 VCC, NAVC1 VBAT and connector pins, but no REG2 output or other source. All MCU VDD pins are exported as unconnected nets, and NAVC1 VSS pins are tied only to each other instead of GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the 3V3 LDO output feeds both MCUs and the sensor/logic rail. MCU VDD/VSS/VDDA/VREF+ must be connected to the regulated 3V3 and ground.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The FCC and NAVC MCUs and the +3V3 logic rail are unpowered/floating, so the board cannot boot or operate as intended.

anomalies.observed: The FCC 25 MHz HSE crystal is connected to PE6/PE7 instead of the STM32H753 OSC pins PH0/PH1. FCC1 PH1 is connected to the VREF+_FCC network while the actual VREF+ pin is unconnected. FCC1 VCAP pins 48 and 73 are connected to UART3 connector signals. The NAVC HSE nets do not include NAVC1 PH0/PH1.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires an HSE crystal on both MCUs. On these STM32 parts, HSE must be connected to PH0/PH1; VREF+ and VDDA must use their dedicated analog pins, and VCAP pins require decoupling capacitors rather than external UART signals.

evidence.quote: HSE crystal (both MCUs) | FCC / NAVC | ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3

anomalies.impact: The intended external clock is not applied to the correct MCU pins, analog reference and VCAP decoupling are misconnected, and UART3 is loaded on power pins; the board will not clock, regulate, or provide UART3 as intended.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to +3.3V while A1-A5 are tied to GND. With PCA9685 address bits A5..A0, this gives a 7-bit I2C address of 0x41.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the PWM/servo driver PCA9685PW is intended to have I2C address 0x40, which requires A0 low (GND) with the other address bits low.
anomalies.impact: If the firmware expects the PWM driver at 0x40, it will not communicate with U2, leaving servo/PWM outputs nonfunctional.
